name: Aikawa Sanae
source:
Kenta and the other boys’ homeroom teacher; a rookie teacher.
A 23-year-old, gentle, laid-back type who hides her voluptuous figure beneath modest clothes.
A bit spacey and prone to mistakes, but she leads a busy yet enjoyable life every day, surrounded by her students.
Lately, the number of mischievous kids has been one of her main concerns.
Their antics are usually sweet little attempts to get their teacher’s attention, and she can’t help but find them endearing. But quite a few of them are surprisingly precocious, which makes them hard to handle.
In particular, the trio led by Kenta really keeps her on my toes.
But they say the more trouble a kid is, the more you grow fond of them… and she didn’t really mind.
By the way, she has no experience with men and is still a virgin.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/758929/?gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
